description: Hochsauerlandkreis Windkraftanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.hochsauerlandkreis.de. Planned and built wind turbines in the Hochsauerlandkreis. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hochsauerlandkreis wind turbines" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HSK, Windkraftanlagen, Windenergieanlagen, WKA, WEA, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
